callouts.text: **R304 is a build-time break, not a flake, and is now the single largest AMD CI regression on record here.** [#32890](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32890) ([`fb207b72`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/fb207b72b02a2adfab3a4a18f5e3b5fa57bb1049), verified merged Aug-01 05:26) added `inclusive_sum` calling `__shfl_up_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, …)` — a 32-bit mask — at `warp.cuh:184` with no wave64 guard; ROCm requires a 64-bit mask (`static_assert sizeof(MaskT)==8`). Every test that JIT-compiles a kernel including `warp.cuh` dies at `ninja exited with status 1` → server exit -9. Fix [#33195](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33195) opened Aug-01 10:16 UTC and is **still not merged**.
